purpose.statement: DEPTPAY is a standalone batch COBOL program that calculates and displays the average salary for a hardcoded department (FINANCE). It populates a single department record with static data, computes the average salary by dividing total salaries by number of employees, and prints the results to standard output.

code_references.snippet:
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           PERFORM AVERAGE-SALARY.
           PERFORM DISPLAY-DETAILS.
           STOP RUN.

business_rules.statement: The department being processed is statically defined as 'FINANCE' located in 'SOUTHWEST'. No dynamic input is accepted; department identity is hardcoded.

code_references.snippet:
MOVE "FINANCE"           TO DEPT-NAME.
           MOVE "SOUTHWEST"         TO DEPT-LOC.

business_rules.statement: The department manager is statically defined as 'Millard Fillmore'. No dynamic input is accepted for manager identity.

code_references.snippet:
MOVE "Millard"           TO MANAGER-FNAME.
           MOVE "Fillmore"          TO MANAGER-LNAME.

business_rules.statement: The number of employees in the department is hardcoded as 19.
The total salary payroll for the department is hardcoded as $111,111.11.

The average salary is calculated by dividing total department salaries by the number of employees (DEPT-AVG-SALARY = DEPT-TOTAL-SALARIES / DEPT-NBR-EMPS). No rounding or zero-divisor guard is applied.

A defect exists in DISPLAY-DETAILS: the Manager Last Name field is never displayed. The second manager DISPLAY statement incorrectly references MANAGER-FNAME again instead of MANAGER-LNAME, causing the first name to be printed twice and the last name to be omitted.

code_references.snippet:
DISPLAY "Manager FNAME: " MANAGER-FNAME.
           DISPLAY "Manager NAME: " MANAGER-FNAME.

inputs.statement: All input data is hardcoded inline within the AVERAGE-SALARY paragraph. There are no external files, databases, or user inputs. The working storage record DEPT-RECORD (comprising DEPT-NAME, DEPT-LOC, MANAGER-FNAME, MANAGER-LNAME, DEPT-NBR-EMPS, DEPT-TOTAL-SALARIES, DEPT-AVG-SALARY) is the sole data structure.

code_references.snippet:
01  DEPT-RECORD.
           05  DEPT-NAME            PIC X(20).
           05  DEPT-LOC             PIC X(12).
           05  DEPT-MANAGER.
                10 MANAGER-FNAME    PIC X(15).
                10 MANAGER-LNAME    PIC X(15).
           05  DEPT-NBR-EMPS        PIC 9(3).
           05  DEPT-TOTAL-SALARIES  PIC 9(7)V99.
           05  DEPT-AVG-SALARY      PIC 9(7)V99.

MOVE "FINANCE"           TO DEPT-NAME.
           MOVE "SOUTHWEST"         TO DEPT-LOC.
           MOVE "Millard"           TO MANAGER-FNAME.
           MOVE "Fillmore"          TO MANAGER-LNAME.
           MOVE 19                  TO DEPT-NBR-EMPS.
           MOVE 111111.11           TO DEPT-TOTAL-SALARIES.

outputs.statement: Output is written exclusively to standard output (SYSOUT) via six DISPLAY statements: Department Name, Department Location, Manager First Name (displayed twice due to defect), Department Average Salary, and Number of Employees.

code_references.snippet:
DISPLAY "Department Name: " DEPT-NAME.
           DISPLAY "Department Location: " DEPT-LOC.
           DISPLAY "Manager FNAME: " MANAGER-FNAME.
           DISPLAY "Manager NAME: " MANAGER-FNAME.
           DISPLAY "Department AVG Salary: " DEPT-AVG-SALARY.
           DISPLAY "Number of employees: " DEPT-NBR-EMPS.

processing_logic.statement: Step 1 – Initialization: Program begins execution at the PROCEDURE DIVISION entry point and sequentially performs two paragraphs before terminating.

code_references.snippet:
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           PERFORM AVERAGE-SALARY.
           PERFORM DISPLAY-DETAILS.
           STOP RUN.

processing_logic.statement: Step 2 – Data Population: The AVERAGE-SALARY paragraph populates all fields of DEPT-RECORD with hardcoded literal values for department name, location, manager name, employee count, and total salaries.

code_references.snippet:
MOVE "FINANCE"           TO DEPT-NAME.
           MOVE "SOUTHWEST"         TO DEPT-LOC.
           MOVE "Millard"           TO MANAGER-FNAME.
           MOVE "Fillmore"          TO MANAGER-LNAME.
           MOVE 19                  TO DEPT-NBR-EMPS.
           MOVE 111111.11           TO DEPT-TOTAL-SALARIES.

processing_logic.statement: Step 3 – Average Salary Computation: The AVERAGE-SALARY paragraph uses a COMPUTE statement to calculate DEPT-AVG-SALARY as the arithmetic quotient of DEPT-TOTAL-SALARIES divided by DEPT-NBR-EMPS.
Step 4 – Display Results: The DISPLAY-DETAILS paragraph outputs six lines to SYSOUT covering department name, location, manager first name (twice due to a bug), average salary, and employee count.

code_references.snippet:
DISPLAY "Department Name: " DEPT-NAME.
           DISPLAY "Department Location: " DEPT-LOC.
           DISPLAY "Manager FNAME: " MANAGER-FNAME.
           DISPLAY "Manager NAME: " MANAGER-FNAME.
           DISPLAY "Department AVG Salary: " DEPT-AVG-SALARY.
           DISPLAY "Number of employees: " DEPT-NBR-EMPS.

processing_logic.statement: Step 5 – Termination: Program terminates normally via STOP RUN after both paragraphs have been performed.

dependencies.statement: No external programs, copybooks, DB2 tables, CICS transactions, or vendor modules are referenced. The program is entirely self-contained with no external dependencies.

error_handling.statement: No error handling is implemented. There is no ON SIZE ERROR clause on the COMPUTE statement, no FILE STATUS checking, no condition codes, no abend trapping, and no rollback logic. A division-by-zero condition (if DEPT-NBR-EMPS were 0) or arithmetic overflow would cause an unhandled runtime abend.

downstream_effects.statement: The program's only output is to standard output (SYSOUT/console). No files are written, no database rows are updated, and no messages are enqueued. Downstream consumers are limited to any process or operator monitoring the job's SYSOUT, which will receive an incomplete display due to the MANAGER-LNAME defect.

code_references.snippet:
DISPLAY "Department Name: " DEPT-NAME.
           DISPLAY "Department Location: " DEPT-LOC.
           DISPLAY "Manager FNAME: " MANAGER-FNAME.
           DISPLAY "Manager NAME: " MANAGER-FNAME.
           DISPLAY "Department AVG Salary: " DEPT-AVG-SALARY.
           DISPLAY "Number of employees: " DEPT-NBR-EMPS.
